text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
And here it is! The Arima Kinen, full of excitement
as a showdown between the Big Three!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
The "Rebel," Katsuragi Ace!
The "Rule Breaker," Mr. C.B.! And
the racing world's greatest "Common Sense," Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: —Who will claim the title of the strongest?! This could drastically reshape the landscape of the racing world going forward!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh? A pre-race interview for me?
(Splash, splash...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Well, we are running, after all.
No, it's not like I hate it or anything.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, if we're talking enthusiasm...
I'm gonna win! That's it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf and Mr. C.B. are both incredible Umamusume. I know that.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's no point in coming all this way
if I just let myself get buried under a big name.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I might be plain, but I'm definitely right here.
I've been running this whole time, all the way down my own path."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Today... I'm gonna win.
I ain't handin' this to anyone...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To me, CB is my natural enemy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Overwhelming speed, a resilient body capable of repeated accelerations, an obsession with racing—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Above all, what I find most troublesome...
is her completely uninhibited, natural way of life.
(Splash, splash...!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I admire her,
she is a born free spirit whom I could never truly imitate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The way she runs across the turf so freely and unconventionally
fascinates people, filling many Umamusume
with admiration and excitement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "As a friend, her back looks so dependable. I'm sure many people were saved thanks to her."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I am certain.
If it is her—she is capable of reigning supreme.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, my ambition will crumble.
That is precisely why I cannot lose today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Our victory on this day
holds countless meanings for me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...That was one heck of a challenge letter,
from both of them.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Broadcasting such overwhelming pressure on air...
Rudolf's going to terrify the underclassmen. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Trainer. You know...
I'm really glad you're my Trainer.”
choice_data_list: What's wrong, all of a sudden?
What's wrong, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I've never wanted to win this badly
in my entire life.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should come up with a strategy now and figure out a more advantageous way to run... just a thought.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thoughts like that cross my mind,
but seeing your face always reminds me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'll just keep being the freely running Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right. That's why I'm so glad
you're my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Please enjoy yourself too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Now, let us raise the curtain on the Arima Kinen.
